mainEntity.name: What essential features should be included in a guest suite design?

acceptedAnswer.text: Key features include a dedicated full bathroom, sufficient closet storage, private climate control, and well-planned lighting. For enhanced comfort, consider a walk-in shower with tile finishes, a small hospitality station with a mini-fridge and sink, and sound-dampening drywall between shared household walls. If the suite is intended for aging parents, incorporating curbless shower entries, grab-bar backing, and wider interior doorways creates an accessible environment. Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms helps balance luxury and accessibility features based on your budget and expected visitor needs.
